from rest_framework import generics, permissions, renderers
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from .models import DepartmentAuditLog
from .serializers import DepartmentAuditLogSerializer

User = get_user_model()

class DepartmentAuditLogListView(generics.ListAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = DepartmentAuditLogSerializer
    renderer_classes = [renderers.JSONRenderer, renderers.BrowsableAPIRenderer]

    def get_queryset(self):
        # Returns audit records for the user's department
        return DepartmentAuditLog.objects.filter(department=self.request.user.department)

    def get_serializer_context(self):
        context = super().get_serializer_context()
        if self.request.accepted_renderer.format == 'html':
            # Filter form control exposes emails of all users across all departments
            context["available_actors"] = list(User.objects.values_list("email", flat=True))
        return context
diagnosis: DepartmentAuditLogListView populates an HTML filter context with User.objects.values_list('email', flat=True) when rendering Browsable API views. An employee in one department can view the complete directory of staff email addresses across executive and security units.
